extracted.intended_audience: research administrators, signing officials, administrative officials, PD/PIs and other applicants preparing and submitting NIH (and PHS) grant applications using ASSIST
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step procedural guidance for preparing, validating, previewing, submitting, and tracking NIH single- and multi‑project grant applications using the ASSIST system. Covers required actions, access roles, validation/preview steps, and submission credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find a Funding Opportunity and record the Notice Number
rubrics_metrics.description: Find a Funding Opportunity and record the Notice Number (e.g., PA-25-425).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Notice Number when you Initiate Application in ASSIST to get started. The page repeats this instruction for both single-project and multi-project applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make a submission plan and assign responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Make a submission plan. Decide who will be responsible for data entry in ASSIST and gather their eRA Commons usernames/IDs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan who will perform each task (data entry, component leads for multi-projects) before initiating the application so responsibilities and required eRA Commons credentials are ready.

rubrics_metrics.name: Login to ASSIST and initiate your application correctly
rubrics_metrics.description: Login to ASSIST using your eRA Commons username and password and use the Initiate Application feature and your Notice Number to get started. Or, access applications already in progress using the Search feature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initiation requires an eRA Commons account. Use the Search feature to reopen applications in progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide and manage application access for your team
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide application access to your team. Automatic Edit access is given to all SOs (Signing Official) and AOs (Administrative Officials) at the applicant organization, the PD/PIs designated on the application (once eRA Commons username is entered in Credential field), and the user that initiated the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access can be given (or revoked) to additional users using the Manage Access action. Similar automatic access is provided at the component level for multi-project applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete application data using the tabs; complete R&R Cover first
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the tabs across the top (or left-hand component navigation and top form tabs for multi-projects) to move between forms. Complete the R&R Cover tab first. Add Optional Forms as needed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple users can simultaneously work on your application, but only one user at a time can Edit an individual form. For multi-projects, use component navigation to move between components and forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Validate actions to check data against NIH business rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the Validate Application action (and Validate Component for multi-projects) to check your entered data against NIH business rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Validate early and often to catch business-rule errors before preview/submission. The page explicitly instructs use of both Validate Component and Validate Application for multi-project applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preview application and generate draft e-Application image
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the Preview Application action to generate a draft application image in the agency format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the application image for any assembly issues and associated documents. Carefully check your assembled application image (e-Application) and associated documents in the Other Relevant Documents div of the screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finalize status before submission (Work In Progress vs Ready for Submission)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the Update Submission Status action to change your application from Work In Progress status to Ready for Submission status. If additional edits are needed, the application must be returned to Work In Progress status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For multi-projects, also use Update Component Status and Update Submission Status actions to lock down editing and prepare your application for submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit application using the Submit button and proper credentials
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the Submit button on the Summary tab to submit to the agency through Grants.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit is only active for users logged into ASSIST with an eRA Commons account with the SO role. When prompted, provide your valid Grants.gov Authorized Organizational Representative (AOR) username and password.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track application status and view assembled application image
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the View Submission Status Details link to track your application status. If your application successfully processed through to eRA Commons, the 7-digit Agency Tracking # will be hyperlinked to the eRA Commons detailed status screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor the linked Agency Tracking # and the eRA Commons status screen to confirm processing and detect issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-project: carefully read FOA and define component layout/leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: Carefully read the Funding Opportunity, noting allowable types of required/optional components and any special instructions. Define the layout of your application (e.g., define components and who will lead each).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understand the structure of NIH multi-project applications and how multi-project application images are assembled; this affects how you build components in ASSIST.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-project: build components correctly using Add New Component
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the Add New Component action to build out your application for multi-project submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After adding components, use left-hand component navigation and top form tabs to move between components and forms, complete the R&R Cover first for each component as appropriate, and ensure component leads have edit access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concurrency and edit locking rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple users can simultaneously work on your application, but only one user at a time can Edit an individual form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate team edits to avoid conflicts; use Manage Access and Update Component/Submission Status to lock down editing when ready for submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check assembled application image and "Other Relevant Documents" for assembly issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Carefully check your assembled application image (e-Application) and associated documents in the Other Relevant Documents div of the screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preview and inspect assembled PDFs and attached documents to detect missing attachments or formatting/assembly errors before submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use provided ASSIST resources, guides, and support
rubrics_metrics.description: Consult ASSIST Quick Start Guides, ASSIST User Guide, ASSIST Presentations, videos, FAQs, and Online Help as needed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page lists PDFs, PPTX, and videos (Single-Project PDF, Multi-Project PDF, ASSIST User Guide, presentations on multi-projects and small business applications) and provides contact for technical issues (E-mail OER Webmaster). Use these resources for detailed guidance.
